To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
isovist-based spatial properties of virtual reality simulated indoor architectural scenes predict experiential qualities in a significant way.
the experiential qualities spaciousness, complexity, and openness of architectural scenes can be predicted by their spatial properties.

(1) isovists are a useful means to describe and predict experiential qualities in open-plan indoor spaces, (2) the experiential qualities spaciousness, complexity, openness, and order can be predicted from spatial properties, (3) the spatial properties that are effective predictors are related to the information rate of the isovists, and (4) the predictive power of the isovist-based approach is superior to the predictive power of a purely geometric approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a generic model for the prediction of the affective quality of an architectural space based on its spatial properties.
the development of a generic model that allows to predict experiential qualities from spatial properties.
a computational approach that allows to automatically predict experiential qualities from spatial properties in arbitrary architectural spaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
isovist-based spatial measurands are a promising approach to predict experiential qualities.
the more a scene is perceived to be spacious, open, complex, and ordered, the more pleasant the scene is experienced.
the experiential qualities can be predicted by a combination of spatial form, spatial layout, and spatial content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
isovists provide a generic tool to describe spatial properties of architectural scenes.
the spatial properties of architectural spaces are not independent from their experiential qualities.
the isovists are a useful tool to describe spatial properties and to predict experiential qualities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
spatial qualities can be effectively predicted by isovist derived measures.
isovists are a powerful tool for predicting experiential qualities in open-plan architectural spaces.
isovists are a promising approach to predict the experiential qualities from the spatial properties of architectural spaces.
